steps.label: 3468-paper1094-reversed-range-normal-modify-for-restore
command: (()=>{if(location.pathname!=='/paper/detail.donga'||new URL(location.href).searchParams.get('paperId')!=='1094'||document.querySelector('.page-wrapper dl dt')?.nextElementSibling?.textContent.trim()!=='1094 (1190)')throw Error('Expected newly saved test paper');const links=[...document.querySelectorAll('a[href]')].filter(e=>{const u=new URL(e.href);return u.pathname==='/paper/modify.donga'&&u.searchParams.get('paperId')==='1094';});if(links.length!==1||links[0].matches('.disabled'))throw Error('Own paper modify unavailable');links[0].click();return {clicked:true};})()

steps.label: 3469-paper1094-reversed-range-restore-input-preflight
command: (()=>{const f=document.querySelector('#paperModifyForm');if(location.pathname!=='/paper/modify.donga'||f?.elements.paperId.value!=='1094'||f.elements.startPageNum.value!=='2'||f.elements.endPageNum.value!=='1'||f.elements.viewFlag.value!=='R'||f.elements.serviceUsage.value!=='C')throw Error('Expected persisted reverse range and baseline metadata');return {id:f.elements.paperId.value,start:f.elements.startPageNum.value,end:f.elements.endPageNum.value};})()
